verdict.rationale: The SDK supports pausing/resuming runs via RunState for human-in-the-loop interruptions, and community discussion references a Temporal-based durable-execution wrapper built atop the Agents SDK, suggesting durable-execution integration is possible. However, there is no first-party documentation of native crash/restart durability, state persistence backends, or an official durable-execution integration guide. Missing for 10: native documentation of surviving process restarts/deploys, official durable-execution integration guide, evidence of state serialization beyond RunState pause/resume, and independent confirmation the Temporal integration is officially supported.
